title: 2D convolution in C
hints: There are four loops: two over output positions (oi, oj) and two over the kernel (ki, kj). The output is (H-KH+1) by (W-KW+1).
Output (oi, oj) reads input row oi + ki and column oj + kj. On a flat row-major array that's index (oi + ki) * W + (oj + kj); the kernel element is k[ki * KW + kj].
Sum into a local accumulator that starts at 0 for every output position, then write it to y[oi * OW + oj], where OW is the output width, not W.

answer.explain: Four nested loops, an accumulator reset per output, and the two row-major index formulas. The one bug to watch is using the input width W where the output width OW belongs when writing y.
